entry: workspace-tools.mjs createWorkspaceToolHandlers().session (the session tool, actions list, send and create) over daemon-session-control.mjs createSessionControl, agent-task-sessions.mjs createAgentTaskSessions and the real session-service.mjs createSessionService on a stub runtime factory; seams: the catalog pages, the bot list, the live work, the archived flags, the report watches (refusing) and the projects

exclusions.a group room: a send to a room's log goes through the desktop room host; the core has none for the session tool and refuses it
exclusions.agent work a session waits on: a status' agentsWorking is the sessions with an agent turn in flight (the catalog's live work); the agent pool rows, the owed agent results and the background agent tasks Node's taskSessionPendingWork also reads (store-agent-worker-rows.mjs, pending-messages.mjs, background-tasks.mjs) have no store in the core and read as none, the case's `pending` seam being the live agent work
exclusions.attached files: a file forwarded with send/create needs the caller's conversation files; the core refuses attachments in this runtime (session_port.rs resolve_attachments)
exclusions.model, effort, worktree: create and send with model, effort or worktree need the model catalog and the worktree host through the session service; the core refuses them
exclusions.random names: a created session id (sess_daemon_<ms>_<32 hex>) is <created>, a create's request id (atask_<uuid>) is <request> and the caller's folder (a temporary directory) is <WORK>
exclusions.reports: the report queue (watches, started line, final report) is not in the core; Node's answer to a watch it cannot store is recorded with that seam refusing
exclusions.scripted catalog: the catalog (listSessions pages and cursors such as `earlier`, readRow rows) is the recorder's own input, as are the live work and the archived flags: Node's real listing is not run here, so the replay may script the same seam (`ScriptedListing`). The production listing (`StoreListing` over a store) is compared against Node's real catalog by the session-listing set (rows whole, order, page size, next cursor, malformed cursor, archived flag, live overlay)
exclusions.service bookkeeping: a case records the catalog pages asked for (listSessions), the prompts the runtime took (runtime.submitAsync) and the session a create made (service.createSession); the service's own calls (materializeSession, the wrapper calls) and the log lines are Node internals; `skipSlashCommands`, which the service stamps on the prompt of a home chat, is dropped

normalised.reason: per-run temp path (or generated name) replaced by a placeholder

product.tree: product tree loaded by the recorder

replay.compare: SessionTool::call over DirectorySessionPort over a real SessionDirectory on the real thread store (the tool answer or refusal of each case; the catalog pages the port asks for; the session a create made read from its stored record; the prompts delivered read from the input row of the turn each started in the session that took it)

normalised.quotaResume.model: status: a failed turn names its model by the display name of the id (routeMeta.model, displayModelName; the recorded quota object is hand-fed with the bare id), so the recorded model and the answer's are both replaced by <model name> after the answer's is checked to be displayModelName of the session's model id
normalised.quotaResume.turnKey: status: the waiting resume comes from a real failed turn of the session; its turn key is generated by that turn (the id of its attempt), so the recorded key and the answer's are both replaced by <turn key> after the answer's is checked to be the key of the resume queued for that turn; the rest of the object (state, provider, resetAt, attempts) is compared whole
